title: A Three-Factor Hull-White Scenario Generator for Macro-Financial Stress Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.26200v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper builds a scenario engine that maps a yield-curve path into a distribution of macro-financial outcomes. A three-factor Hull-White model generates arbitrage-free curves whose factors are simulated under the physical measure, with an estimated and reported market price of risk. A Minnesota-prior VARX maps the simulated curves into weekly equity returns, the federal funds rate, the Weekly Economic Index, inflation and a bank Marginal Expected Shortfall proxy, with a sign-restricted policy shock adapted to weekly data. Evaluated out of sample from 2017 to 2024, the term-structure block has the lowest forecast error in 13 of 20 maturity and horizon cells, and the density forecasts are well calibrated for the continuously moving variables. At weekly frequency the curve carries no incremental information about these variables once their own lags are controlled for, so the engine's value lies in conditioning on a specified curve path,

translated_title: 用于宏观金融压力预测的三因子Hull-White情景生成器
translated_abstract: 本文构建了一个情景引擎，将收益率曲线路径映射为宏观金融结果的分布。三因子Hull-White模型生成无套利收益率曲线，其因子在物理测度下进行模拟，并估计和报告了风险市场价格。带有Minnesota先验的VARX模型将模拟曲线映射为周度股票收益、联邦基金利率、周度经济指数、通胀以及银行边际预期损失代理变量，并采用了适应周度数据的符号约束政策冲击。在2017年至2024年的样本外评估中，期限结构模块在20个期限与预测期的组合中有13个实现了最低预测误差，且对于连续变动的变量，密度预测校准良好。在周度频率上，一旦控制了这些变量自身的滞后项，收益率曲线便不再包含关于这些变量的增量信息，因此该引擎的价值在于以指定的曲线路径为条件进行情景分析。
tldr: 该论文提出结合三因子Hull-White模型与Minnesota先验VARX的情景引擎，能将指定的收益率曲线路径转化为宏观金融结果分布，样本外预测表现优异，其核心价值在于以给定曲线路径为条件生成宏观金融压力情景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a scenario engine combining a three-factor Hull-White model with a Minnesota-prior VARX that maps specified yield-curve paths into distributions of macro-financial outcomes, demonstrating strong out-of-sample forecasting performance whose value lies in conditioning macro-financial stress scenarios on given curve paths.
